fixit.Sealed: New / sealed (terms tab lists the grade with no description)
fixit.Open: Activation OK (30<days from a year activation), box in good condtion, plastic on all accessories & phone screen. Never used.
fixit.A: perfect mint (Samsung tab grading; terms tab has no A text)
fixit.B+: very good condition. 1 tiny scratch ok (Samsung tab grading)
fixit.B: OEM, no cracks, Light Use, fully functional
fixit.C: Fully functional, heavy/deep dents or scratches, cracked glass, good oem LCD.
fixit.D: Bad LCD, Touch Issues, Must be fully functional phone just needs new screen. After Market also = Bad LCD ***BLACK LCD / UNABLE TO TEST = DOA***
fixit.DOA: No Power / Signs of Life; Cracked, Bad LCD, Water damaged, not fully tested mixed issues TOO HEAVY BEND / DAMAGE / MISSING PARTS MAY BE SUBJECT TO LOWER PRICE. No iCloud
fixit.B-: few deep scratches / heavy scratches / multiple medium scratches (Samsung tab grading)
fixit.SWAP: New device swapped from apple, no box, no signs of any use, never used. Must have plastic.  "N" MODEL NUMBER
fixit.HSO: New device, no box, no signs of any use, never used. Must have plastic. NO "N" MODEL NUMBER
